# laravelforge_monitor (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge server monitor by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the monitor.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the monitor belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `minutes` (Number) Frequency in minutes to evaluate the monitor.
- `notify` (String) Email address notified when the monitor is in an alert state.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator against the threshold (`gte` or `lte`).
- `state` (String) Current state of the monitor (`OK`, `ALERT`, or `UNKNOWN`).
- `state_changed_at` (String) Timestamp the monitor state last changed.
- `status` (String) Installation status of the monitor (e.g. `installed`).
- `threshold` (Number) Percentage threshold to alert on once breached.
- `type` (String) Metric type (`cpu_load`, `disk`, `free_memory`, or `used_memory`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
